description: Source file implementing functions to insert references to interface block members at the beginning of main in shader code, working around driver issues on Mac. It manipulates AST nodes related to shader interface blocks.

methods.name: AddNodeUseStatements
methods.description: Recursively adds nodes or array elements to the sequence for referencing interface block members.

methods.name: AddFieldUseStatements
methods.description: Adds use statements for a shader variable to the sequence.

methods.name: InsertUseCode
methods.description: Inserts use statements for an interface block into the sequence.

methods.name: InsertUseCode
methods.description: Overloaded function to insert use statements for all blocks into the sequence.

methods.name: UseInterfaceBlockFields
methods.description: Main function that inserts use statements into the AST for interface blocks and validates the AST.
